text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria finishes 1st!
Gran Alegria puts on a total display of dominance!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
S-She's so strong! She's the real deal...!
Without a doubt, she's an Umamusume who'll go down in history!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You've grown so much... Gran Alegria.
Physically, of course, but mentally too.
There's such stability in your running now.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: 90 mph, just as envisioned!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Well then—it's a match, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon returning to the waiting room, Gran Alegria spoke up
with an unusually serious expression.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember the risks involved
in aiming to conquer three divisions?
choice_data_list: That your senses will be thrown off and your running will fall apart.
Throwing off your instincts and wrecking your running form.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
With your new personal rule,
you won't have to worry about that anymore.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I felt that promising response from today's run.
Even if I take on Medium distances, I'm sure I won't waver.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I have proven myself.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Conquering three distance categories—it's okay if I aim for that, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If the risk is gone, then there's no problem.
However... are you sure you haven't overlooked any other risks?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is wishful thinking making me believe it's all right?
...Doubt makes me hesitate to decide.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
I don't want to have any regrets!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "...Taiki-senpai told me that the regret of not trying will stay with you forever."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's why, even if there's a risk,
I still wanted to take on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I have to make a decision right now.
So I don't miss out on my prime."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I don't want you
to have any regrets either, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"The fact that you told me
you'd chase the same dream as me..."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Because I believe in you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I intended to chase that dream together with her.
If I go back on that promise, I know I'll regret it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, I am a Trainer.
If I make an emotional choice and ruin her future—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regret alone isn't going to fix this.
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Don't think about things like positions or responsibilities.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me
what you truly desire, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"The future I want is the one
I reach together with you, Trainer!!"
choice_data_list: (! ...If that... is what you wish for...)
(! ...If that... is what you desire...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If her future will never see the light
without taking on this challenge—!
choice_data_list: —I want to aim for a three-division sweep with Gran!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
choice_data_list: I swear I'll give my all to support you!
I swear I will devote everything I have to supporting you!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I will definitely conquer all three distance categories!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She puffed out her chest with a voice brimming with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—A thunderous roar could be heard.
Acclamations praising Gran Alegria.”
choice_data_list: (If it's her... she can pull it off!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter what hardships lie ahead,
I know she'll overcome them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And once more,
the days of chasing the same dream began.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Setting our Senior Class goal on conquering three distance categories, we re-evaluate our roadmap moving forward.
choice_data_list: Let's go with the Takamatsunomiya Kinen for our next race.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Right on schedule, we'll keep aiming for Sprint GⅠs.
First up, conquering the sprint division!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And naturally, sweeping the Spring and Autumn Mile GⅠs!
Ah, might as well throw in the Spring and Autumn Sprint GⅠs too—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu!
The Senior Class is going to be infinite miles of fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A knock? Who could it be?
I'll go check!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah, Master! Good afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to interrupt.
I need to talk to you two.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Before that—
Gran, congratulations on the Hanshin Cup."

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: I watched it on-site, and it was a great run that really showed how much she's grown.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wah, thank you very much!
Did you come all the way to Hanshin to watch?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I wanted to see your growth with my own eyes.
And having done so—I am now certain.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"You no longer need my help.
Today, you graduate!"
choice_data_list: Graduation!?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You all possess the strength
to choose your own path and forge ahead on your own.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you guys the ones
who understand that best?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "...You're right! We'll be fine. Right, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: ...Yeah.
...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for everything!
Those 120 miles were a blast!
choice_data_list: Thank you so much for everything...!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Hello. Ah, Tazuna-kun.
Is this about the matter I requested?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "Yes. Everything was finalized just now. As originally planned, late next year poses no problem."

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll tell those girls to start preparing for late next year, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Graduating from my mentor's tutelage.
It came completely out of the blue."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad they recognized I can stand on my own two feet.
And yet, what comes to mind is—"

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I find myself almost wanting to see
Gran conquer all three distance tiers...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Brooding over something again, are we?
choice_data_list: Gran...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It seems like one worry just follows right after another.
What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no hiding things, okay?
'Cause that would hurt me by 35 miles.
choice_data_list: S-Sorry! It's, um... about Master...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Master?
You're not feeling anxious just because you graduated, are you?
choice_data_list: Conquering all three classes is my master's dearest wish.

text_block_list.text:
"Throughout my mentor's long career as a Trainer,
one cherished dream remained unfulfilled: conquering three distance categories."
They said they wanted to see that achievement with their own eyes.
Conquering three distance categories—it's a lingering regret he carries to this day.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...I see. For Master, it's
an 'if' that can never fade away, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Then load that dream onto me too—
every single bit of it!
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's what you want, right, Trainer?
Because I don't want you to have any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I'll grant it! Eveeery last one of them!
choice_data_list: Still, my master's feelings from his entire career as a trainer...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'll sublimate all those feelings
into something greater.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Please don't ask me
if this will become a burden, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I am Gran Alegria, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I really can't compete with her.
To think she'd laugh off even a historic feat
like it was nothing."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still, with Gran Alegria—!
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's show them together: conquering all three divisions.
Yeah. Let's show them together: a triple crown sweep across three categories.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Hehe, it's time to return the favor!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
First, for the Takamatsunomiya Kinen,
I'll give it my all at 120 mph!
